notes: Fact-check 2026-10-27: downgraded from 'none' to 'unknown'. The checklist (source 1) lists only a 'Personal essay' and the requirements page (source 3) says each application platform has its own essay prompts, but no SMU page says there are no SMU-specific questions, and third-party guides dated for 2026-27 report two required 250-word SMU prompts in the Common App (not used as a source; no official SMU page publishing them was found). Check the SMU section of the Common App. 'none' rests on SMU's international application checklist (source 1), which lists only application, personal essay, transcript, test scores (optional), English proficiency, recommendations and a resume (optional) and no school-specific writing; the general requirements page (source 3) likewise only says each application platform has its own essay prompts (250-650 words). The pages do not name the cycle; the checklist deadlines (Nov 1 and Jan 15) match the Common App 2026-27 grid. SMU's separate scholarship essays (for example President's Scholars, Hunt Leadership Scholars) were not checked on SMU's own scholarship pages and are not included. No published date for the proof of funds was found.
